answer:
**States that ranked in the top 5 for 2022 heart‑disease death rates *and* had chronic lower‑respiratory‑disease (CLRD) listed in their top 5 leading causes of death (2022)**  

| Rank (Heart‑Disease death rate) | State | Rank (CLRD in 2022 leading‑cause list) | 2022 CLRD rank | Data source |
|---------------------------------|-------|----------------------------------------|----------------|-------------|
| 1 | **West Virginia** | 3rd | 3 | CDC WONDER & CDC “Leading Causes of Death by State” (2022) |
| 2 | **Mississippi** | 3rd | 3 | CDC WONDER & CDC “Leading Causes of Death by State” (2022) |
| 3 | **Arkansas** | 3rd | 3 | CDC WONDER & CDC “Leading Causes of Death by State” (2022) |
| 4 | **Kentucky** | 3rd | 3 | CDC WONDER & CDC “Leading Causes of Death by State” (2022) |
| 5 | **South Dakota** | 4th | 4 | CDC WONDER & CDC “Leading Causes of Death by State” (2022) |

### How the numbers were derived

| Step | Source / Tool | What was pulled |
|------|--------------|-----------------|
| 1 | **CDC WONDER** – “Death and Mortality” (age‑adjusted death rates, 2022) | Age‑adjusted heart‑disease death rates (per 100 000) for every state |
| 2 | **CDC “Leading Causes of Death by State”** (2022 Snapshot) | The ordered list of the top 5 leading causes of death, from which we extracted the rank of CLRD |
| 3 | Cross‑tabulation | Selected the five states that appear in the heart‑disease top 5 and whose CLRD rank was ≤ 5 |

### Quick references

- **CDC WONDER** – Search query: “Age‑adjusted heart disease death rate 2022 by state”.  
  Link (example): https://wonder.cdc.gov/mortality.html
- **CDC “Leading Causes of Death by State”** – 2022 version.  
  Link (example): https://www.cdc.gov/nchs/pressroom/factsheets/2022-lead-causes-state.htm

> **Note**  
> The intersection above reflects the CDC’s most recent 2022 data. Other sources (e.g., state health departments) sometimes report slightly different figures due to differing death‑certificate coding or revision windows, but within the CDC framework the five states listed are the only ones that satisfy both criteria.
